notes.title: Thank You
notes.notes:
Hello,

Thanks to everyone who purchased Eternal Samurai :)

This was my first commercial steam game and I'm glad with the responses I've gotten on the project. It was designed to be very small as there is a lot more I need to learn.

I'm working on new games and someday would like to add more to this game. I had a prototype for a zombie horde mode that I might polish up one day.

My main joy/goal is to try and have people play and enjoy my games. I hate to ask but if anyone that has purchased the game could leave a review that would help me out a lot :)

I hope everyone is well and playing fun games :)

notes.title: Duel Mode
notes.notes:
This most recent update includes a new mode on the main menu called "DUEL".

This mode allows for 2 players to locally fight each other.

- 4 arena levels
- 8 characters
- multiple colours to choose from

This mode allows for fast/short fights that will allow players to test their skill against each other!

notes.title: Duel Mode
notes.notes: Adding local multiplayer duel mode allowing player to fight each other

notes.title: Duel Mode
notes.notes:
Some testing going on right now but a basic multiplayer build is working where two players can choose a character, and battle each other in small simple duels.

Will allow players to pick a character and pick their colour. 

Right now I'm going to normalize all the character stats [u]for multiplayer only[/u] meaning that when dueling the attack/jump/speed stats will all be equal. Arguing about allowing the players to pick if the duel should use the single player stats.
